text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High rate of GPU prefill OOMs on gpu-prod-12. 18 container restarts in the last 7m, multiple CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY traces. Pager: oncall-ml.
oncall-ml: I'm up, looking. Seen customer beacon errors? Any immediate mitigations?
sre-alex: confirm, nodes gpu-prod-12 and gpu-prod-13 showing repeated kubelet restarts tied to container SIGKILL after OOM. Logs: `cudnn` OOM, memory spike during prefill path. ETA 5m for triage.
eng-runtime-maya: moving to bridge. Quick mitigation options:
- disable prefill for heavy-context routes via runtime flag
- force fallback to quantized model variant (smaller KV cache)
- evict KV cache more aggressively on prefill
Which can we flip quickly?
oncall-ml: can we toggle prefill=false for model:rw-large-ql3 on prod route `/chat/long`?
eng-runtime-maya: yes, we have a feature-flag endpoint. Patch: `POST /admin/flags` payload `{"model":"rw-large-ql3","prefill":false}` — ops only. Applying now.
incident-bot: Deploy job started by eng-runtime-maya (deploy/flag-toggle/1785102468) :shipit: 
eng-ml-chen: note: rw-large-ql3 holds large KV and long-window users. If we disable prefill, latency for some flows increases but should avoid OOM.
cust-success-jordan: customer beacon-prod-9 reported streaming disconnects at 12:13 UTC, likely linked. We're prepping a customer note.
sre-alex: flag patch applied, rolling to serving instances on gpu-prod-12. Monitoring.
eng-runtime-maya: also enabling eviction policy `prefill_short_circuit=true` for the affected pool to drop prefill allocations in favor of generation.
oncall-ml: seeing OOM rate drop on gpu-prod-12 from ~150/min to ~12/min. Container restarts decreasing.
product-ana: any customer-impacted SLAs? Should coordinate a post-incident message.
cust-success-jordan: affected customers: beacon-prod-9 (major), fintech-kite (medium). We'll send initial ack within 30m. Preparing template.
eng-ml-chen: additional action: add a per-route max_context_length clamp (32k -> 12k) for heavy routes. That requires a config rollout; engineering can do a canary.
sre-alex: canary started on gpu-prod-14. No regressions so far.
oncall-ml: still seeing a stray node flip on gpu-prod-13 (kubelet restart). SRE to isolate node?
sre-alex: isolating node gpu-prod-13 from the router (drain) to stop new assignments: `kubectl drain node/gpu-prod-13 --ignore-daemonsets`.
eng-runtime-maya: temporary mitigation: enable routing fallback to smaller model `rw-medium-ql3` for bursty requests: runtime rule `route_fallbacks` updated.
incident-bot: Note: auto-shed triggered for some customers to protect capacity. Logs: shedding 5% of requests from non-SLA tenants.
oncall-ml: summary so far: prefill OOMs triggered by long-window requests on rw-large-ql3. Immediate mitigations: feature-flagged prefill off, eviction short-circuit, fallback routing, node drain. Customer impact limited to streaming disconnects and higher latency for long contexts.
eng-runtime-maya: we should add a throttle rule on `/chat/long` to prevent single tenants from bursting tokens 10k+ in steady-state.
product-ana: agreed, add to roadmap: per-tenant long-context quotas + UX warning.
cust-success-jordan: sending customer ack now. Template: "We're aware of the GPU OOM issue affecting long-context chat. Mitigations in progress; some requests may see higher latency. We'll follow up with RCA." Will cc accounts.
eng-ml-chen: follow-ups: (1) add more aggressive KV eviction heuristics (owner: eng-runtime-maya) (2) add per-route context clamp (owner: eng-ml-chen) (3) improve observability: expose per-model KV allocations (owner: eng-platform)
oncall-ml: assigning incident postmortem: owner eng-runtime-maya. Target: initial RCA in 48h.
eng-runtime-maya: taking it. I'll start notes in the incident doc and include memory profiles, heap dumps, and sample traces.
sre-alex: final check: OOMs down to 0 in last 3m on gpu-prod-12, node drains stable. Moving to monitor mode.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Resolved (mitigated). Follow-ups and RCA tracking at /incidents/1785102468. :white_check_mark:
eng-runtime-maya: postmortem tasks created, will sync on daily standup.
product-ana: notify sales & support channels about potential churn risk for long-window customers.
cust-success-jordan: sent customer ack and scheduled 1:1 for beacon-prod-9 tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
oncall-ml: thanks team. I'll close pager in 30m unless we see recurrences. :thumbsup:
